author: Suresh Chunara
review_text: Very disappointing experience. The app is slow and often crashes. Transactions fail frequently, and when money gets stuck, customer support is not helpful. In my case, the app froze during payment, so I already paid the merchant in cash. After several days, the app automatically deducted the money from my account as well. This is unacceptable. The app needs serious improvement in performance, reliability, and transaction handling.
